state: A 4x4 matrix of nibbles A[row][column], with row and column in 0..3.
round_definition: For round j=0..4, apply Y_j[row][column] = S(X_j[row][column]).
For j=0..3, set U_j = MixColumns(ShiftRows(Y_j)) and X_(j+1) = U_j xor K_(j mod 2) xor RC_j.
The output of round 4 is unconstrained after its S-box layer; no key is added after that layer.
Initial and final whitening are omitted. This does not restrict whether a concrete pair exists for a given K0,K1 under this fixed internal characteristic.

shift_rows.definition: If a state is flattened column-major, SR_out[i] = SR_in[output_to_input[i]].

mix_columns.definition: Independently in every column, output row r is the XOR of the other three input rows.

master_key: K0 and K1 are independent 4x4 matrices of nibbles and together form the 128-bit master key.

key_bit_order.bit_numbering: bit=0 is the least significant bit of a nibble

affine_equation_semantics: All reported key equations are over GF(2). Any independent equation basis defining the same affine subset is acceptable.
